summary.headline: Perambulation Calculation Example
summary.text: Instructions for calculating astrological perambulations by converting elapsed days into months, adding five minutes per month, and applying the result to the ascensions of the horoscope. A worked nativity example dated from year 6548 to 6588 places the horoscope’s perambulation in Sagittarius.
